javax.microedition.broadcast.connection
Interface BroadcastDatagramConnection

All Superinterfaces:
BroadcastConnection, javax.microedition.io.Connection, javax.microedition.io.DatagramConnection
public interface BroadcastDatagramConnection
extends BroadcastConnection, javax.microedition.io.DatagramConnection

BroadcastDatagramConnection abstracts a broadcast connection as a datagram connection. It implements the javax.microedition.io.DatagramConnection interface of the Generic Connection Framework to provide a standard I/O interface to read the connection's data as datagram packets.

BroadcastDatagramConnections are receive-only. In some broadcast implementation, the content of the connection may be updated by the system in runtime. A BroadcastConnectionListener can be registered to listen for any changes to the connection.

BroadcastDatagramConnections can be retrieved from ServiceContext.getBroadcastDatagramConnection(ServiceComponent) method when the components have been identified. Data from the datagram can be read as long as the ServiceContext is in PRESENTING state or inPREPARING_MEDIA transition state.

See broadcast connection examples for some usage examples.
